jobs.name: ExecuTorch weekly shortlist
jobs.prompt: Use executorch-pm shortlist mode. Read the current Focus part in SKILL.md and collect up to 10 eligible issues within those scopes, reporting shortages without broadening focus, write only issue-disptach.html、issue-disptach.pdf and Result.md in yenhao-huang/daily executorch/<time>/, present to the user and wait for selection. Never start development or write to community repositories. Preserve existing selections and tracked PR rows in today's Result.md; coordinate with daily checking to avoid duplicate snapshots.

jobs.name: ExecuTorch daily PR progress
jobs.prompt: Use executorch-pm daily Result snapshot mode at 04:00 Asia/Taipei. Every day publish executorch/YYYY-MM-DD_HHmmss/Result.md in yenhao-huang/daily, even without status changes. Reuse today on reruns and preserve older dates. Carry forward all tracked PRs and selections, reconcile older missing rows, verify current states and use exactly 未發 PR, PR 未 merge, Done with the separate four-stage detail. Link previous snapshot and original shortlist. On API failure preserve prior status and mark check uncertainty. Progress-only days output Result.md alone. Notify only on meaningful changes; quiet notifications must not skip daily output. Never write to community repositories or trigger development.
jobs.scope: PR open/closed/draft/merged status and daily Result snapshot
jobs.persistence: current container lifetime; restart cron after container restart
